sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Establishes guidelines for designing applications in alignment with business and technical goals. Promotes consistency and usability across systems. Supports scalability and maintainability. Encourages modular and service-oriented design. Facilitates collaboration between business and IT teams.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves consistency and quality of application design. Enhances user experience and system usability. Supports maintainability and scalability. Reduces development time and cost. Aligns IT solutions with business needs.
